title: Star Catcher
tagline: Fly Kitty’s rocket past friendly planets and catch the falling stars!
howToPlay: Drag your finger or mouse, or use the arrow keys, to fly Kitty's rocket. Every star you catch lights one star of a real constellation: build Cassiopeia, the Southern Cross, Orion, the Little Dipper and the Big Dipper, one at each planet, and hear each one's name and a true fact. Gems add a little twinkle and a magnet pulls stars in. Sleepy space rocks just make you dizzy. After five constellations, fly home to see your whole night sky.
learning: Counting, real constellations and star patterns
